title: Asking a Yes-or-No Question
label: ch:mr-polar-question
canDo: I can turn any statement I own into a yes-or-no question with kaa, hear one carried by the voice alone, and write it with one trailing mark.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R33-ask-and-answer and run a two-turn exchange: ask whether there is tea and answer it, then ask permission and decline.
